name: 03_investigating_gdpr
description: Flagship scenario: a storage bucket goes public, then a large upload lands in it, then a suspicious API call fires from the same environment. Three signals correlate into one incident that exercises the full pipeline and is likely to trip the Root Cause Agent's gdpr_flag.
expected_outcome: correlates to correlated_count=3, severity escalates to critical, enhanced with actor/action/outcome data -> investigating

signals.summary: User engineer@company.com changed production analytics bucket ACL to public-read from external IP — critical data exposure risk, immediate investigation required.
Service account svc-analytics-exporter uploaded 4.2GB customer data file to the now-public bucket — potential GDPR breach, correlates with ACL change 2 minutes prior.
Deployment service svc-deploy-bot invoked Azure OpenAI API against analytics resource — unusual for deployment automation, possible exfiltration channel or compromised service account.
